style_prompt: Production-ready 2D mobile game UI art for a charming cat-themed 2048 game. Match the existing warm ivory paper, coral, teal, mustard and charcoal visual language: bold hand-painted shapes, rounded enamel-like plates, clean dark contour, restrained highlights, slight handmade asymmetry, readable at 64 px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, mockup, or UI screenshot.

assets.prompt: Create a 2 by 2 sprite sheet on one perfectly flat solid chroma-key green #00FF00 background with exactly four isolated horizontal rounded button plates in strict row-major order, with very wide green gutters. Do not use #00FF00 inside any plate. Cell 1 primary button: rich raspberry berry red with a warm coral inner highlight and deep charcoal outline. Cell 2 secondary button: berry pink with muted teal accent edge and charcoal outline. Cell 3 reward button: golden apricot with raspberry edge and a small empty area at the left for a coin icon. Cell 4 light button: pale raspberry cream with a berry border. All plates have matching rounded corners, consistent proportions, a hand-painted enamel surface, empty centers for programmatic labels, no icons, no text, no shadows outside the plates. Make each plate fill most of its cell while remaining fully separated from the green background.
